Evidence is the translators' and auditors' own reports as relayed to the coder by the manager, not coder-invented output; verdict counts span all nine namespaces of the locale and are repeated in every row. Per-finding text lives in the audit reports and the PR thread (damianvtran/local-operator#3597); unresolved minors/nits are deferred, not fixed. Dates are the day the coder recorded the row.
